records.paper_id: 20241102-国泰君安-风格轮动量化研究系列之一：量化视角多维度构建成长价值风格轮动策略
records.calc_method: 成长与价值相对波动率，滚动1年95%和5%分位数作为阈值，结合相对净值5日和20日均线交叉确认信号
records.condition:
# 计算成长/价值日收益率
growth_ret = growth_close.pct_change()
value_ret = value_close.pct_change()
# 相对波动率：成长/价值滚动60日标准差之比
rel_vol = growth_ret.rolling(60).std() / value_ret.rolling(60).std()
# 滚动1年分位数上下轨
upper = rel_vol.rolling(252).quantile(0.95)
lower = rel_vol.rolling(252).quantile(0.05)
# 均线
ma5_close = (growth_close / value_close).rolling(5).mean()
ma20_close = (growth_close / value_close).rolling(20).mean()
# 稀疏输出：对输入分别zscore后组合
rel_vol_z = calc_rolling_zscore(rel_vol, window=252)
upper_z = calc_rolling_zscore(upper, window=252)
lower_z = calc_rolling_zscore(lower, window=252)
ma_diff_z = calc_rolling_zscore(ma5_close - ma20_close, window=252)
factor = pd.Series(0.0, index=rel_vol.index)
# 价值拥挤（rel_vol极低且均线金叉）=> 偏成长
cond_value_crowded = (rel_vol < lower) & (ma5_close > ma20_close)
factor[cond_value_crowded] = (lower_z - rel_vol_z)[cond_value_crowded].abs() * ma_diff_z[cond_value_crowded].abs()
# 成长拥挤（rel_vol极高且均线死叉）=> 偏价值
cond_growth_crowded = (rel_vol > upper) & (ma5_close < ma20_close)
factor[cond_growth_crowded] = -((rel_vol_z - upper_z)[cond_growth_crowded].abs() * ma_diff_z[cond_growth_crowded].abs())

# 以RSI近似超买超卖判断（个股级RSI不可得时，用成长/价值指数RSI代理）

monthly_ret = mktP_ret.resample('ME').sum()  # 日频Dretwd求和近似月收益

DI = trimmed.std(axis=1)  # 横截面标准差
raw = DI - DI.rolling(12).mean()  # 相对12个月均值偏离
factor = calc_rolling_zscore(raw, window=120)

records.condition:
# SEMIVLOT_60D_DN：下行半方差（负收益部分的标准差）
# 成长/价值比率 >1 => 成长成分股下行风险相对更小（或上行更强） => 利好成长

ret_wide = S_DQ_ADJCLOSE.pct_change()   # 个股日收益率宽表

def semivol_down(ret_ser, window=60):
    """60日下行半波动率（仅负收益参与计算）"""
    return ret_ser.rolling(window).apply(
        lambda x: x[x < 0].std() if (x < 0).sum() > 1 else np.nan,
        raw=True
    )

semivol_dn = ret_wide.apply(lambda col: semivol_down(col, window=60))

# 成长成分股等权平均
growth_comps = AIndexHS300FreeWeight[
    AIndexHS300FreeWeight['S_INFO_WINDCODE'] == '399370.SZ'
]['S_CON_WINDCODE']
sub_1 = semivol_dn[growth_comps].mean(axis=1)

# 价值成分股等权平均
value_comps = AIndexHS300FreeWeight[
    AIndexHS300FreeWeight['S_INFO_WINDCODE'] == '399371.SZ'
]['S_CON_WINDCODE']
sub_2 = semivol_dn[value_comps].mean(axis=1)

# 比率 >1 => 成长下行波动 > 价值下行波动 => 价值更稳定 => 价值占优
# 故需翻转：比率高 => value
raw    = sub_1 / sub_2
factor = calc_rolling_zscore(raw - 1, window=504) * (-1)

    lambda x: np.polyfit(np.arange(len(x)), x, 1)[0], raw=True
)

)

        reg = LinearRegression().fit(x, y)

        std_resid = resid / resid.std()
        results.append(std_resid.iloc[-n:].mean())
    return pd.Series(results, index=ind_ret.index[window-1:])

# 方向翻转：溢价从低位回升时应为正值（growth）
# 用输入变量分别 zscore 后组合，避免稀疏输出污染 zscore

upper_z = calc_rolling_zscore(upper, window=756)
lower_z = calc_rolling_zscore(lower, window=756)

# 溢价从低位回升：premium.shift(1) < lower.shift(1) and premium > premium.shift(1) => growth(+)
cond_growth = (premium.shift(1) < lower.shift(1)) & (premium > premium.shift(1))
# 溢价从高位回落：premium.shift(1) > upper.shift(1) and premium < premium.shift(1) => value(-)
cond_value  = (premium.shift(1) > upper.shift(1)) & (premium < premium.shift(1))
